title: Adding Soap Stone To Our Off Grid A-Frame Home
description:
We only have a few major projects left in this portion of our off-grid A-Frame home before we can begin building the deck and bedroom wing of the house.  The finishing details of a home seem to take the longest but they really bring the whole interior together giving it a much more finished look.  Today we are excited to add soapstone to our home and check a few more things off our to-do list.
Shop Our Apparel: https://www.bunkerbranding.com/pages/wild-wonderfull-off-grid
Thanks for watching! Be sure to LIKE & SUBSCRIBE!

Link to Lehman's Hardware where we sourced our Vermont Bun Baker wood stove, stove pipe, wood stove accessories and soapstone: https://www.lehmans.com/

**Find us on Instagram and Facebook to see some of the stuff we don't share here on YouTube**
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WildWonderfulOffGrid   
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wildwonderfuloffgrid/

We are a couple who are building our own home from the ground up in the mountains of West Virginia.  After living near the city our entire lives we finally decided to sell it all, pack up our 3 kids and live in an RV on our 73 acres while we built our own off-grid house and learned to lived a more self-reliant life.
author: Wild Wonderful Off-Grid
